prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Convert ONLY this bench to AUTHENTIC LOW-RESOLUTION PIXEL ART while preserving this exact high overhead camera, broad exposed seat top, silhouette, dark cedar construction and small pastel flowers. The final art must consist of a STRICT 64 columns by 40 rows logical pixel grid, each logical pixel enlarged to an identical 16x16 hard square. It should look like a real 64x40 SNES farming-game sprite enlarged without smoothing, NOT a detailed painting reduced later. Deliberately simplify grain into a few 1-3 logical-pixel marks, each nail a single logical pixel, plank gaps and outlines exactly one logical pixel thick. Choose about 5 cedar wood tones plus warm dark outline, 3 sage leaf tones, cream/blush petals. Strong readable dark outlines and dark one-pixel seat plank gaps. Five broad horizontal seat planks clearly separated, each top surface visible; a foreshortened backrest at upper edge. Warm desaturated cedar browns, NO orange glaze. Individual square pixel clusters must be visibly obvious even at full output resolution. No smooth grain, soft gradients, stippling, microtexture, photographic lighting or anti-alias. All empty grid cells truly transparent. Single complete bench only, no floor, no captions, no second object, no side or eye-level front view. Keep the high angle looking steeply downward.
